name: email
author: Artel
description: Email handler. List folders, list and read emails via IMAP, send emails via SMTP.

api_description.name: list_email_folders
api_description.description: List IMAP folders available in the connected email account

api_description.name: list_emails
api_description.description: List recent emails from the inbox

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return (default 20)

after_uid.description: Only return emails with UID greater than this value, oldest-first. Pass "0" to start from the oldest email in the inbox. To page forward, pass the id of the last (newest) email from the previous page. Mutually exclusive with before_uid.

before_uid.description: Only return emails with UID less than this value, also oldest-first. To page further back, pass the id of the first (oldest) email from the previous page. Mutually exclusive with after_uid.

api_description.name: read_email
api_description.description: Read the full content of an email by its UID

api_description.name: send_email
api_description.description: Send an email from the connected account via SMTP
